{{Top|leg}}
'''Group Mind''' was an [[Ee mental power]], and part of the mental skills category. This skill allowed all [[Ee]] to communicate [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] with one another. Ee had to be within thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] to be part of the Group Mind, and could form chains to keep in contact with one another.
